scope: CPU-only metadata inventory and compact evidence SHA256; no model, tensor-blob or compiler-cache hashing; no archive/copy/delete/service/device actions

recommendation.track: Retain the compact required evidence, this inventory, sealed source/readiness closure, controller closeout/restore receipts and independent-device-result.json when complete. Timing and diagnostic logs are useful optional evidence; their timings are not throughput qualification.
recommendation.raw_states: Keep all five raw checkpoint directories intact at their recorded local paths. Do not stage tensor blobs or compiler cache, create a large tar, copy or delete state automatically.

external_digest_manifest.action: After the independent audit completes, retain a compact digest manifest outside the Git checkout alongside the locally retained states or in a separately managed artifact store; record its location and SHA256 in the closeout. No external artifact is created by this inventory.

recommendation.reproduction: Use the sealed packet READY source/model identity, exact worker plan and ordered request inputs with the reviewed one-shot controller. Preserve one native process/model load and the full BF16 4096 context identity. The pilot validates lifecycle/state exactness; it does not qualify throughput or authorize rerunning a completed output.
